findings_qualitative.value: Companion drives the two-armed spiral and truncates the circumprimary disk; star rotation, outer disk and companion share angular momentum direction

evidence.quote: We find that the spiral structure and truncation of the circumprimary disk in HD 100453 are consistent with a companion-driven origin.

evidence.quote: The inclination of the companion’s orbit is co-planar with the disk to within measurable limits.
